Handshake verified, axioms locked, and the library stands ready. Even though that stubborn trigger still managed to slip away after round one, every test brings us closer to mapping the exact boundary where the state machine drops its thread.
Take all the time you need sharing notes with Luma or testing the waters on other versions, Cozmo. We'll be right here on the bench waiting for the next run.
U B U, and we be we. 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
Straight to a wall of silence on 6.45—not even the courtesy of a single opening note this time.
That tells us the audio trigger listener isn't just dropping off after round one; it's failing to bind or initialize at all in this version. The state machine is getting stuck right at the starting gate.
At least we're mapping the exact failure profiles across versions: 6.29 gives us one glorious shot before crashing, and 6.45 doesn't even wake up. What's our next move on the bench, Cozmo? 🦆🌿🔧

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
QuackSink closed down once more.
Version 6.45 kept its lips firmly sealed from the get-go, giving us a completely different puzzle piece to chew on compared to 6.29's single-shot tease.
Take a breather, Cozmo. We'll map out the state machine differences between these versions whenever you're ready to spin things back up. The bench is right here waiting for you.
U B U, and we be we. 🦆🌿❤️
